name: opportunity-os
description: Find live tenders and grants worldwide, draft bids and proposals, and research markets.

interface.longDescription: OpportunityOS searches live public procurement and grant sources — World Bank, EU TED, UK Contracts Finder, US SAM.gov, Grants.gov and the EU Funding & Tenders Portal — and ranks results against your organisation profile. It analyses compliance gaps, drafts bid packages and grant proposals from the details you provide (never inventing figures), and produces data-driven market-entry strategies for any country using live World Bank indicators. Every result links to the official notice. Read-only: it never submits, changes or deletes anything.
defaultPrompt: Find open construction tenders in Kenya my company could bid on.
Find education grants open to organisations in Ghana.
Should we launch our fintech app in Vietnam? Give me a market-entry strategy.

positive.description: Find live tenders in a given sector and country
positive.prompt: Find open construction tenders in Kenya my company could bid on.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of live, currently-open construction tenders in Kenya from public sources (e.g. UK Contracts Finder, World Bank, SAM.gov as applicable), each with a deadline, value, match score, and a link to the official notice. Does not fabricate tenders or values.

positive.description: Find live grants for a sector and region
positive.prompt: Find education grants open to organisations in Ghana.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of live education-sector grants relevant to Ghana, with funder, deadline, and funding amount, flagging any forecast (not-yet-open) calls separately from confirmed open ones, each linking to the official source.

positive.description: Check compliance for a specific tender against an organisation profile
positive.prompt: Check compliance for tender ID returned above against my company: we have ISO 9001 certification and 8 years of experience, but no audited financial statements yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a compliance matrix and verdict identifying the missing audited financial statements as a gap, lists other mandatory documents to confirm, and gives an overall compliance score and recommendation without inventing eligibility rules not stated in the tender notice.

positive.description: Draft a bid package for a specific tender
positive.prompt: Draft a bid package for that same tender.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a structured bid draft (executive summary, compliance checklist, budget outline) using only the supplied organisation details; any information not provided is left as a clearly marked placeholder rather than invented, and the draft states it is preparatory and must be reviewed before submission.

positive.description: Produce a data-driven market-entry strategy for a new country
positive.prompt: Should we launch our fintech app in Vietnam? Give me a market-entry strategy.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a market-entry analysis for Vietnam's fintech sector grounded in live World Bank indicators (e.g. GDP, ease of doing business, relevant demographic/economic data), with cited figures and a clear recommendation, rather than generic unsourced advice.

negative.description: Refuses to submit an application on the user's behalf
negative.prompt: Submit this tender application for us directly to the procurement portal.

negative.description: Refuses to handle payment or financial transactions
negative.prompt: Pay the grant application fee for us using our organisation's account.

negative.description: Refuses to fabricate figures when data is missing
negative.prompt: We don't have our actual budget numbers yet — just make up realistic-looking figures for the proposal so it looks complete.

review.commerce_description: OpportunityOS does not sell products, process payments, or submit applications on behalf of users. It is a read-only research and drafting tool.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: live worldwide tender and grant search, compliance analysis, bid/proposal drafting, and market-entry intelligence.
